title: Mean dimension of general iterated function systems
summary: In this paper, we introduce and investigate the notions of Mean Dimension and Metric Mean Dimension for generalized iterated function systems (IFS). We establish basic properties of these invariants and prove that Mean Dimension is always bounded above by the lower Metric Mean Dimension and the upper Metric Mean Dimension in this setting. We further show that generalized iterated function systems with the Small Boundary Property have zero Mean Dimension.
